title: Two Regularity Problems on Analytic Tent Spaces
summary: We study two regularity problems on Hardy-type analytic tent spaces $\mathcal{AT}^p_{q,α}$ on the unit disk: fractional integration and randomization of Taylor coefficients. For fractional integration, we characterize completely the boundedness and compactness of the Hadamard, Flett, and Riemann--Liouville operators between analytic tent spaces, and obtain parallel results for analytic Triebel--Lizorkin spaces.
